title: ハンドパレットトラック
description: テーパーフォーク、荷重ローラー、操舵車輪、油圧シリンダーと操作ハンドルを個別に造形したパレットジャック。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Manual pallet jack with tapered forks, tandem load rollers, paired steering wheels, hydraulic ram, lifting linkage and loop handle. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
